name: semurg-memory
description: Your AI forgets. Semurg gives every AI agent one memory that lasts, shared across your tools and your team, with sources. Connects Cursor to your Semurg memory over MCP.

SEMURG_URL.description: The MCP address of your Semurg memory. A fresh install serves http://127.0.0.1:4000/v1/mcp

SEMURG_API_TOKEN.description: Your Semurg API token (the installer prints it; also in ~/.config/semurg/token)

SEMURG_SCOPE.description: Which memory this connection reads and writes. Agents that use the same scope share what is stored
